item.title: Holiness Rooted in Grace: Avoiding Legalism
item.description: Learn how Christians pursue holiness without legalism by grounding obedience in the gospel, relying on the Holy Spirit, and walking in humility.

item.title: True Peace vs. Counterfeit Calm, Finding Peace in Christ
item.description: True peace is not found in New Age practices or self-help calm. This episode explains how lasting peace comes only through repentance and faith in Jesus Christ.

item.title: Job 12: Wisdom and Power Belong to God Alone
item.description: In Job 12, Job declares that wisdom and power belong to God alone. Learn how God’s sovereignty governs creation, nations, and every life.

item.title: Ordinary Means, Extraordinary Grace: How God Grows Us
item.description: God grows Christians through ordinary means—His Word, prayer, sacraments, and fellowship—showing how ordinary grace produces lasting spiritual growth.

item.title: Psalm 119:18 — Open My Eyes: Praying for Spiritual Sight
item.description: Psalm 119:18 teaches us how to pray when God’s Word feels dry. Ask the Lord to open your eyes and behold wondrous things in Scripture.

item.title: Eternal Conscious Torment vs. Annihilationism
item.description: A biblical response to annihilationism, explaining why Scripture teaches eternal conscious torment and why this doctrine matters for the gospel.

item.title: The Gospel According to Eastern Orthodoxy | Biblical Evaluation
item.description: Samuel Farag evaluates Eastern Orthodoxy’s teachings in light of Scripture, comparing key doctrines to the biblical gospel and calling believers to discernment.

item.title: Job 13: Trusting God When Understanding Fails
item.description: In Job 13, Job trusts God even when understanding fails. This episode explores persevering faith, honest prayer, and hope rooted in God’s character.
